_meta.status: FINAL - D7 decisions applied; seeded into pull_rates (Phase G)
decisions_applied: D7 #3 - sets cut entirely: OP01, OP05, OP13, EB02 (all rows removed)

D7 #4 - EN-observed rows only: every row whose source_note carries the x2 JP->EN derivation marker ('JP figure doubled for EN') removed. Also removed on the same basis: OP10 SEC (seeded 0.5 was a JPx2-vs-EN compromise, not an EN observation) and the modern-era SR rows OP10-OP15 (the S6.5 'JP guarantee x2 vs EN breaks' conflict class - sensitivity appendix S.3 classifies OP10 SR as JP-derived). L rows survive: EN-sourced (onepiecechases 5.0), contested but carrying no x2 derivation.
D7 #5 - all SP rows dropped (S8.1 pricing-population mismatch); PRB01/PRB02 skipped (no rows existed in the draft); TR rows stay at confidence=low (EN single-source)

OP08 AA dropped (not in the D7 list): the AA class resolves ZERO cards under printed_set_code='OP08' (appendix S.1/S.4 #3 - parallels retained base rarities there), so the slot could never price; its ~2 pulls/box fold into the BULK remainder note
Every BULK row recomputed as 288 - sum(surviving hit slots per box) so per-set per_box sums to exactly 288.000 and spec S3.5 weights sum to 100%
BULK per_case is null on every row: per_box x 12 (3252-3372) exceeds the pull_rates numeric(6,3) column range (max 999.999). Derive as per_box x 12 when needed; no UI consumes it.
_meta.region_basis: All rows are for English product (24 packs x 12 cards per standard box; EN case = 12 boxes).
_meta.resolution: set_code -> sets.id via sets.code; rarity_code -> game_rarities.id via game_rarities.code (game_id = one_piece). rarity_code null = BULK slot (rarity_id null).
